title: Apple Crisp with Rye Crumble
description: This quick and easy apple crisp is rustic and beautiful when made in a cast iron pan! Unpeeled apples and rye flour help make it healthier.
ingredients: 4 medium unpeeled apples, cored and thinly sliced
3 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cut into 1/4-inch cubes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly coat an 8- or 9-inch baking pan with cooking spray.
Mix together apples, sugar, 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, lemon juice, and cinnamon in a medium bowl. Pour into the prepared baking pan.

Combine 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, rye flour, butter, brown sugar, salt, and nutmeg in the empty bowl. Mix with a wooden spoon or with your hands until butter is distributed throughout flour and sugar mixture. Pour in milk and mix until combined. Press mixture together and spread over apples in the baking pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until crumble topping is browned and juices are bubbling, about 40 minutes.
